blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Agent performance depends on both reasoning ability and the environment in which it acts.
We study test-time AI-for-AI, asking how a Builder can learn to construct better execution environments for a Target while both models’ weights remain fixed.
To make the Builder’s experience reusable, we introduce meta-skills : principles specifying when support is needed and what resources to provide. The Builder learns these principles from Target’s execution feedback on the development set, then uses the frozen skill bank to construct harnesses for unseen tasks. Across Harness-Bench and NewtonBench, full-bank meta-skills improve macro-average performance by 8.95 percentage points over no-skill construction, and 12.02 points over direct delivery of the same bank to the Target.
These results highlight the value of translating experience into executable support. Gains when the same model serves both roles further suggest a path to system level self-improvement through learning to build better environments.
blocks.zh:
代理性能既取决于推理能力,也取决于其行为环境.
我们研究测试时间AI-for-AI,询问构建者如何学会为目标构建更好的执行环境,同时两个模型的权重保持不变.
为了使建设者的经验可以重复使用,我们引入了元技能:规定何时需要支助和提供何种资源的原则。 构建者从目标对开发集的执行反馈中学习这些原则,然后利用冷冻的技能库来构建用于隐形任务的工具。 在Harness-Bench和Newton Bench两地,全银行元技能提高了宏观平均业绩,比无技能建筑提高了8.95个百分点,比直接向目标交付同一银行高出12.02个百分点。
这些成果突出了将经验转化为可执行支持的价值。 当同一模式为两个角色服务时,收益进一步表明,通过学习建设更好的环境,实现系统层面的自我改进。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: An AI agent’s performance depends on both its reasoning ability and the environment in which it acts [ 11 ] . Consider a capable PhD student who spends days repeating experiments because configurations and results are scattered across scripts and notes. An effective advisor can address this bottleneck by establishing a shared experiment log, reproducible tools, and a clear validation workflow, helping the student devote more effort to scientific judgment. This analogy suggests a complementary direction for improving AI agents: learning how to provide the support that makes their existing capabilities more effective [ 3 , 13 ] .
blocks.zh: AI代理的性能取决于其推理能力及其行为环境[11]. 考虑一个有能力的博士生,因为配置和结果分散在脚本和笔记之间,所以会花几天重复实验. 一个有效的顾问可以通过建立一个共享的实验日志,可复制的工具,以及明确的验证工作流程来解决这个瓶颈,帮助学生将更多的精力投入科学判断. 这一类比为改进人工智能代理人提供了补充方向:学习如何提供支持,使其现有能力更加有效[3、13]。

blocks.en: AI-for-AI (AI4AI) at test-time offers a route to this goal by enabling AI systems to design agent programs, workflows, and harnesses [ 1 , 15 , 3 ] . This form of AI4AI involves two complementary roles: a Builder , which designs and provides support, and a Target , which uses that support to solve tasks. We study this relationship through harness construction, where the Builder creates a harness comprising instructions, resources, and executable mechanisms for the Target. Just as an advisor learns from a PhD student’s progress to refine their guidance, the Builder can learn from the Target’s execution to improve its support. Building on recent work on meta-level learning [ 13 ] , we therefore ask: how can the Builder turn the outcomes of its own harnesses into reusable knowledge for supporting future tasks?
blocks.zh: AI-for-AI(AI4AI)在测试时通过使AI系统能够设计代理程序,工作流程,并利用[1,15,3],为实现这一目标提供了一条路线. 这种形式的AI4AI涉及两个互补的角色:一个是设计并提供支持的构建者,另一个是使用该支持解决任务的目标. 我们通过利用建筑来研究这种关系,建造者为目标创建了包含指令、资源和可执行机制的桥梁。 正如一名顾问从博士生的进步中学习如何完善他们的指导一样,建设者也可以从目标的执行中学习如何改进其支持。 因此,在最近关于元层面学习的工作[13]的基础上,我们问:建设者如何将自己利用的成果转化为可重复使用的知识,以支持未来的任务?

blocks.en: To make this experience reusable, we distinguish the knowledge needed by the Builder from task skills used by the Target . Task skills describe how to perform a task [ 9 ] ; the Builder instead needs principles for designing the support that helps the Target perform it. We call these reusable support principles meta-skills . Empirically, each meta-skill shuold specify when support is needed, what capability or resource to provide , and how the Target should use it while retaining responsibility for judgment.
blocks.zh: 为了使这种经验可以重复使用,我们将建设者所需的知识与目标使用的任务技能区分开来。 任务技能描述如何完成一项任务[9];而构建者则需要设计帮助目标完成该项任务的支持的原则. 我们称这些可重复使用的支持原则为元技能。 从经验上讲,每个元技能修饰器都具体说明何时需要支助,提供何种能力或资源,以及目标应如何使用,同时保留判断责任。

blocks.en: In this paper, we connect the learning and implementation of these principles through a construction–execution–reflection loop. Starting with an empty meta-skill bank, the Builder constructs harnesses for development tasks, reviews the resulting Target execution records and scores, and adds or revises principles based on the observed evidence. After skill learning, the bank is frozen and guides fresh harness construction for each held-out task. Learning thus changes the Builder’s external knowledge and the support it constructs, while both the Builder’s and Target’s model weights remain fixed.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们通过构建-执行-反演循环将这些原则的学习和执行联系起来。 从一个空的元技能库开始,构建者构建了用于发展任务的优势,审查了由此产生的目标执行记录和分数,并根据观察到的证据添加或修改了原则. 在技能学习之后,银行被冻结,并指导每个被扣留任务的新的吊带构造。 因此,学习会改变建设者的外部知识及其构建的支持,而建设者的模型权重仍然固定不变。

blocks.en: We evaluate three Targets on Harness-Bench and NewtonBench under fixed Target execution budgets. The full-bank meta-skill Builder achieves a 65.31% macro-average score, exceeding the no-skill Builder by 8.95 percentage points and full-bank independently learned Target skills by 10.93 points. It also outperforms direct delivery of the same bank to the Target in all six settings. These comparisons suggest that meta-skills can help the Builder become a more effective advisor: they guide support design, while Target skills guide task execution. In our setting, teaching the Builder to translate experience into executable support can therefore be more beneficial than directly teaching the Target additional task skills.
blocks.zh: 在固定的目标执行预算下,我们评估了哈内斯-奔驰和牛顿奔驰的三个目标. 全库元技能建设者实现65.31%的宏观平均分数,超过无技能建设者8.95个百分点,全库独立学习目标技能10.93分. 在所有六种情况下,它也比直接向目标提供同一银行的业绩要好。 这些比较表明,元技能可以帮助构建者成为更有效的顾问:它们指导支助设计,而目标技能则指导任务的执行。 因此,在我们所处的环境里,教建设者将经验转化为可执行的支助比直接教授目标的额外任务技能更为有益。

blocks.en: Because meta-skills encode reusable principles, we further examine how they develop and whether they remain useful beyond the setting in which they were learned. Through analysis, we discover that repeated reflection can strengthen the guidance, and transfer studies suggest possible meta-skill reuse across Builders and Targets. The Builder and Target can also be instances of the same model: across three such settings, meta-skills improve scores by 18.71 points on average over no-skill construction. These results suggest that a model can improve its own execution by learning to build better support for itself, establishing harness design as a promising route to system-level self-improvement.
blocks.zh: 由于元技能编码可重复使用的原则,我们进一步审查这些原则是如何发展起来的,以及它们是否在学习的范畴之外仍然有用。 通过分析,我们发现反复反思可以加强指导,转移研究显示,在构建者和目标之间可能存在元技能再利用。 建构器和目标也可以是同一模式的例子:在三个这样的设置中,元技能比无技能构造平均提高18.71分。 这些结果表明,一个模式可以通过学习建立更好的自我支持,将利用设计确立为系统一级自我改进的有希望的途径,从而改进自身的执行。

blocks.en: Looking ahead, AI4AI broadens the goal of agent learning: agents can learn both to solve problems and to create the conditions for others to succeed. Improving how Builders provide guidance and resources may be as consequential as improving how Targets use them. Better agents may begin with better advisors.
blocks.zh: 展望未来,AI4AI拓宽了代理人学习的目标:代理人既可以学习解决问题,也可以为他人成功创造条件. 改进建设者提供指导和资源的方式可能与改进目标如何使用同样具有影响。 更好的特工可能从更好的顾问开始。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: AI-for-AI uses AI systems to automate model development and agent design. For model development, AIDE uses an LLM agent to write and refine machine-learning pipelines, while MLE-Dojo provides environments for training and evaluating agents performing this engineering work [ 2 , 6 ] . For test-time agent design, the optimization target becomes the system surrounding a fixed model: Automated Design of Agentic Systems and AFlow both focus on searching agent programs and workflows [ 1 , 15 ] , while Darwin Godel Machine evolves its own agent code, and Meta-Harness searches harness implementations using execution feedback [ 14 , 3 ] . Within this direction, strong-to-weak harness construction uses a stronger Builder to supply executable support for a weaker Target [ 5 ] . We build on this setting by learning reusable construction principles from Target executions during offline skill learning, then freezing them to guide fresh harness construction for each test task, with both models’ weights fixed.
blocks.zh: AI-for-AI使用AI系统实现模型开发和代理设计自动化. 对于模型开发,AIDE使用LLM剂来书写和完善机器学习管道,而MILE-Dojo则提供环境来培训和评价从事这一工程工作的代理人[2,6]. 对于测试时代理设计,优化目标成为围绕固定模型的系统: Automic Design of Agentic Systems and AFlow 都专注于搜索代理程序和工作流程[1,15],而达尔文·戈德尔机器则会演化自己的代理代码,而Meta-Harness搜索则利用执行反馈来控制执行[14,3]. 在这一方向上,强力至微弱的牵引力建设使用更强大的构建器为较弱的目标[5]提供可执行支持. 我们以此为基础,通过在离线技能学习中学习目标处决的可重复使用的建筑原则,然后冻结这些原则,以指导每个测试任务的新利用构造,同时固定两个模型的重量。

blocks.en: Agent skills preserve procedural knowledge for reuse: Voyager stores executable routines, while ExpeL and Agentic Context Engineering accumulate textual insights and contextual playbooks [ 7 , 17 , 16 ] . Methods for improving these resources include SkillRL, which co-evolves skills and policies through reinforcement learning, and Evo-Harness, which compiles execution experience into transferable solver skills [ 10 , 9 ] . SkillsBench complements these methods by measuring skill utility with curated packages and deterministic verifiers [ 4 ] . At the meta level, learned knowledge guides agent improvement itself: Meta Context Engineering learns skills for constructing context files and code, while MetaSkill-Evolve evolves policies for improving task skills [ 13 , 8 ] . Within this direction, our Builder learns those principles from its own harness outcomes and implements them as task-specific environments for a separate Target , specifying when support is needed, what capabilities to supply, and the Target’s responsibilities.
blocks.zh: 代理技能为再利用保留程序知识: Voyager存储可执行的例行程序,而ExpeL和Agentic Context Engineering则积累了文字洞察力和背景剧本[7,17,16]. 改进这些资源的方法包括SkillRL(通过强化学习共同传授技能和政策)和Evo-Harness(将执行经验汇编为可转移的解答者技能[10,9]). 技能 法官通过用包件和确定性核查员衡量技能效用来补充这些方法[4]。 在元一级,学习的知识指导改进代理人本身: 元上下文 工程学习了构建上下文文件和代码的技能,而MetaSkill-Evolve则演化了提高任务技能的政策[13,8]. 在这个方向上,我们的建设者从自身利用成果中学习这些原则,并将这些原则作为单独目标的具体任务环境加以实施,具体说明何时需要支助、提供何种能力以及目标的责任。

blocks.en: At the end of each skill-learning step, the Builder reviews its generated harnesses and the Target’s execution feedback to identify an observed error or recurring burden that better support could address, then compares the resulting lesson with the current bank. It revises an existing meta-skill when the evidence corrects or strengthens its guidance, adds a new meta-skill for a distinct reusable support need, or keeps the bank unchanged when no update is justified. Each batch permits at most one addition or revision, which must cite supporting evidence from that batch to keep the learned guidance grounded in observed behavior.

blocks.en: As summarized in Table 1 , the framework exposes seven optional harness component families: instructions, memory, context organization, composed tools, execution control, verification and recovery, and workspace preparation. The Builder selects and implements these components, deciding what memory stores, when it is retrieved, and which tools and resources the Target receives. Within the resulting harness, the Target reasons over observations, uses the available tools, and remains responsible for the final submission.

blocks.en: The Target operates within a Builder-created harness, while the Builder operates within a framework we design. Specifically, we provide shared interfaces, execution isolation, design guidance, and resource limits, with identical construction permissions and bounded interface-repair opportunities across conditions. These fixed priors underpin our workflow for automated meta-skill learning, harness construction, and Target execution. Our contribution thus shifts design effort to the Builder level, enabling it to turn execution experience into reusable support principles and adapt their implementation to individual tasks.
blocks.zh: 目标在构建者创造的绳索内运行,而构建者则在我们设计的框架内运行. 具体来说,我们提供共享接口,执行隔离,设计指导,以及资源限制,具有相同的施工权限和跨条件的限定接口修复机会. 这些固定的前科支撑了我们自动化元技能学习、利用建设和目标执行的工作流程。 因此,我们的贡献将设计工作转移到建设者一级,使其能够将执行经验转变为可重复使用的支助原则,并使其执行适应各项具体任务。

blocks.en: Consider an artifact edited after validation, making the earlier check potentially outdated. A meta-skill’s when field identifies this condition; provide requests version tracking and revalidation; and use directs the Target to inspect the current validation result before submitting, while retaining responsibility for content judgment and correction. The Builder could then implement this principle with file-version memory and a validation tool. In Appendix we trace two actual test episodes from learned principles through Builder-written code and Target tool calls to final artifacts.

blocks.zh: 4.1 实验装置

blocks.en: We evaluate the effect of test-time learned support on task performance using Harness-Bench and NewtonBench, which cover agent workflows and interactive scientific law discovery, respectively [ 12 , 18 ] . For each benchmark, we reserve 10% of tasks for learning and use the remainder exclusively for evaluation. See Table 2 for details.
blocks.zh: 我们利用Harness-Bench和Newton Bench来评价测试时间学习支持对任务绩效的影响,它们分别涵盖代理工作流程和交互式科学法发现[12,18]. 对于每个基准,我们保留10%的任务用于学习,其余则专门用于评价。 详情见表2。

blocks.en: We use GPT-5.6-Sol as the Builder model, and evaluate Gemini-3.6-Flash, Qwen3.8-Flash, and GPT-OSS-120B as Target models. For each Builder–Target–benchmark combination, the meta-skill bank starts empty and is updated over two development-set passes, with at most one evidence-grounded keep , revise , or add update per task. The bank is then frozen for testing, while the Builder constructs a fresh harness for each test task.
blocks.zh: 我们使用GPT-5.6-Sol作为构建器模型,并评价双子座-3.6-Flash,Qune3.8-Flash,以及GPT-OSS-120B作为目标模型. 对于每个构建器 - 目标 - 基准组合,元技能库开始空置,然后通过两个开发设置的通道更新,最多有一个基于证据的保存,修改,或者添加更新每个任务. 银行随后被冻结进行测试,而建设者则为每一项测试任务建造了新的吊带.

blocks.en: All models use temperature zero and high reasoning effort (or the corresponding thinking mode), with a 16K output-token limit for harness generation and an 8K limit for skill update. For the benchmark budget, Harness-Bench allows 30 model turns, 30 tool calls, and 96K cumulative tokens per task; NewtonBench allows 12 turns, 10 tool calls, and 192K tokens.
blocks.zh: 所有模型都采用温度零和高推理努力(或相应的思维模式),对牵引生成有16K输出-托肯限制,对技能更新有8K限制. 对于基准预算,Harness-Bench允许30个模型转折,30个工具调用,每个任务96K累积符;Newton Bench允许12个转折,10个工具调用,以及192K符号.

blocks.en: Harness-Bench reports the deterministic completion-oracle score over 95 test tasks, averaged and scaled to a percentage. NewtonBench reports symbolic-structure accuracy over 292 test tasks. Both use end-to-end evaluation, divided by the fixed number of test cases: valid native outcomes are retained, while audited harness-construction failures receive a score of zero because no executable harness is produced.
blocks.zh: Harness-Bench报告确定性完成-甲骨文得分超过95项测试任务,平均并缩放到一个百分比. 牛顿奔驰报告符号结构精度超过292个测试任务. 两者都使用端到端评价,除以固定的测试案例数量:有效的本土结果被保留,而审计的牵引-构造失败则因为没有产生可执行的牵引力而获得0分.

blocks.en: We compare five baselines. Learned guidance is supplied either in full or through BM25 top-2 retrieval. • Native environment: The Target solves tasks in the shared neutral environment, without learned guidance or Builder-generated support. • No-skill Builder: The Builder constructs harnesses with the same construction space and budget as our method, but with an empty skill bank. • Direct Builder skills: The Target receives our Builder’s meta-skills directly as instructions, with no Builder-generated harness components. • Independent structured Target skills: An equally budgeted GPT-5.6-Sol learner iteratively extracts and refine structured problem-solving skills from the Target’s own neutral-environment executions. The resulting bank is supplied directly to the Target. • Mined free-form Target skills: GPT-5.6-Sol consolidates the Target’s neutral-environment development trajectories into free-form notes in one offline pass. These notes are supplied directly to the Target. Our Builder meta-skill conditions instead provide the retrieved or full bank to the Builder, which compiles it into task-specific harness components such as instructions, memory, context, tools, controllers, verification, or workspace preparation. The full-bank Direct baseline therefore controls for semantic knowledge, while No-skill Builder controls for construction capability, serving as complementary ablations of our method. Please see Appendix C for more setting details.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了五个基线。 获得的指导意见要么全部提供,要么通过BM25顶级-2检索提供。 • 支助 土著环境: 该目标在共享中立的环境中解决任务,没有学习到的指导或构建者生成的支持. • 支助 无技能构建器 : 建筑师用同样的建筑空间和预算 来利用我们的方法, 但有一个空的技巧库。 • 支助 直接构建者技能 : 目标直接接受我们构建者的元技能作为指示,没有构建者产生的绳索组件。 • 独立结构 一个预算相同的GPT-5.6-Sol学习者反复从目标本身的中性环境处决中提取和完善结构性解决问题的技能。 由此产生的银行直接提供给目标。 • 支助 被埋没的自由形态 目标技能:GPT-5.6-Sol将目标中性环境发展轨迹整合为一个离线通道中的自由形态笔记. 这些笔记直接提供给目标。 我们的构建器元技能条件为构建器提供了检索或完整的库,由构建器将其编译为任务特定的控制器组件,如指令,内存,上下文,工具,控制器,验证,或工作空间准备. 因此,全库直接基线控制语义知识,而无技能建设者控制建筑能力,是我们方法的补充。 详见附录C。

blocks.zh: 土著环境: 该目标在共享中立的环境中解决任务,没有学习到的指导或构建者生成的支持.

blocks.en: No-skill Builder: The Builder constructs harnesses with the same construction space and budget as our method, but with an empty skill bank.
blocks.zh: 无技能构建器 : 建筑师用同样的建筑空间和预算 来利用我们的方法, 但有一个空的技巧库。

blocks.en: Direct Builder skills: The Target receives our Builder’s meta-skills directly as instructions, with no Builder-generated harness components.
blocks.zh: 直接构建者技能 : 目标直接接受我们构建者的元技能作为指示,没有构建者产生的绳索组件。

blocks.en: Independent structured Target skills: An equally budgeted GPT-5.6-Sol learner iteratively extracts and refine structured problem-solving skills from the Target’s own neutral-environment executions. The resulting bank is supplied directly to the Target.

blocks.en: 4.2 Main results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Table 3: Test performance (%) on every task in the fixed test splits with GPT-5.6-Sol as Builder in all settings. Bold marks the best result in each model–benchmark column.
blocks.zh: 表3:在固定测试中与GPT-5.6-Sol作为构建器在所有设置中分拆的每项任务的测试性能(%). 粗体标记每个模型-基准栏中的最佳结果.

blocks.en: We present the main results and baselines in Table 3 , and highlight the following key findings.
blocks.zh: 我们在表3中介绍了主要结果和基线,并着重指出以下主要结果。

blocks.en: Giving the same full meta-skill bank to the Builder consistently outperforms giving it directly to the Target , improving every model–benchmark pair by up to 25.43 points and 12.02 on average. This gap shows that the gains come not merely from exposing the Target to better knowledge, but from operationalizing that knowledge before execution. The Builder can translate a declarative meta-skill into persistent state, executable tools, verification logic, or control decisions, reducing the burden on the Target to interpret and apply the advice correctly at inference time. Meta-skills therefore function less as solver prompts and more as a compact language for provisioning task-specific support.
blocks.zh: 将同样的全元技能库提供给建设者, 这一差距表明,收益不仅来自将目标暴露为更好的知识,而且来自在执行前将这种知识付诸实施。 构建者可以将一个宣告性元技能转化为持续状态,可执行工具,验证逻辑,或控制决定,减轻目标在推论时间正确解释和运用建议的负担. 因此,Meta技能作为解答器的提示功能较少,作为提供任务特定支持的紧凑语言功能也较少.

blocks.en: With construction capability held fixed, the full-bank Builder outperforms the no-skill Builder in all six settings, with an average gain of 8.95 points. These results suggest that experience adds value beyond the ability to construct scaffolds: it helps the Builder decide which support to build and how to integrate it with Target behavior. The gains nevertheless vary across Targets and benchmarks, suggesting that accumulated guidance must be adapted to the Target and task rather than assumed uniformly useful.
blocks.zh: 随着施工能力的保持固定,全库建设者在所有6个环境都超过了无技能建设者,平均收益8.95分. 这些结果表明,经验在构建脚手架的能力之外增加了价值:它有助于构建者决定建设哪些支持以及如何将其与目标行为融合. 然而,不同指标和基准的收益各不相同,这表明,必须调整累积指导,使之适应目标和任务,而不是认为统一有用。

blocks.en: Relative to the no-skill Builder, gains on NewtonBench are positive across all three Targets and average 10.96 points, versus 6.95 points on Harness-Bench. NewtonBench requires agents to coordinate experimentation, reasoning, and valid symbolic submission, creating recurring coordination failures that scaffolding can address. Harness-Bench spans more heterogeneous workflows, where effective support depends more on Target-specific planning and tool use . This contrast suggests that accumulated experience is most useful when failure modes recur consistently across tasks and Targets.
blocks.zh: 相对于无技能建设者,牛顿奔驰的得分在所有三个目标上都是正面的,平均得分为10.96分,而哈内斯奔驰的得分则为6.95分. 牛顿奔驰要求代理商协调实验,推理,以及有效的象征性提交,造成反复出现的协调失误,脚手架可以解决. 有效支持更依赖于针对目标的规划和工具的使用。 这一对比表明,当各种任务和目标的失败模式不断重复时,积累的经验最有用。

blocks.en: The full skill bank outperforms top-2 retrieval in five of six settings, with an average gain of 7.19 points on NewtonBench. This pattern suggests that a compact meta-skill bank offers complementary procedures whose combined value may be missed by lexical retrieval. Full-bank access allows the Builder to consider these procedures together when designing support, making it a strong default at the evaluated scale. The exception, however, indicates that broader access is not uniformly beneficial and motivates retrieval methods that account for both skill complementarity and the Target’s likely response to support.
blocks.zh: 全技能库在6个设置中的5个位置上超越了顶级-2检索,在牛顿奔驰上平均收获7.19分. 这种模式表明,一个紧凑的元技能库提供了补充程序,其综合价值可能因词汇检索而失去。 全银行访问允许构建者在设计支持时一起考虑这些程序,使它成为评价尺度的强烈默认. 然而,这一例外表明,更广泛的访问并非一致有益,并激励人们采取检索方法,既考虑到技能的互补性,又考虑到目标可能采取的支持措施。

blocks.en: 5 Analysis
blocks.zh: 5 分析

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Test performance as Builder experience is refined. The two NewtonBench curves improve mainly after the second pass; Harness-Bench displays both steady improvement and late regression.
blocks.zh: 图2:作为构建者经验的测试性能得到完善. 牛顿奔驰的两条曲线主要在第二次通过后有所改进;哈内斯奔驰同时呈现出稳定的改进和晚回归.

blocks.en: 5.1 Effect of Meta-skill Refinement
blocks.zh: 5.1 Meta技能效应

blocks.en: Meta-skills develop through repeated Builder reflection, but additional updates need not improve teaching. To examine this progression, we freeze the skill bank after zero, one, or two complete development passes and evaluate each version on the full test split. Figure 2 reports results for both Gemini and Qwen Targets.
blocks.zh: Meta技巧通过反复的Builder反射来发展,但额外的更新不需要改进教学. 为了检查这个进展,我们冻结了零后的技能库,一,两个完整的开发通行证,并在完全测试分时评价每个版本. 图2报告双子座和Quen目标的结果。

blocks.en: On NewtonBench, the first pass changes each Target’s score by less than 1.1 points, whereas the second adds 13.01 points for Gemini and 12.33 for Qwen. Across all settings, the average gain from zero to two passes is 10.42 points. Manual inspection suggests that early update gathers local observations, while later revision connects them into reusable interventions . This delayed improvement is consistent with the value of iterative revision. The lower Mined Target skill score also motivates going beyond offline trajectory summarization, although that comparison changes both the learning procedure and skill recipient.
blocks.zh: 在牛顿奔驰(Newton Bench)上,第一个传球将每个目标的得分变化不到1.1分,而第二个传球则增加了双子座13.01分,奎恩12.33分. 在所有设置中,从0到2次通过的平均收益为10.42分. 手动检查表明,早期更新收集当地观察,而后来的修订则将它们与可重复使用的干预联系起来。 这一延迟改进符合迭代修订的价值。 较低的 " 地雷目标 " 技能分数也刺激了离线轨迹的总结,尽管这种比较既改变了学习程序,也改变了技能接受者。

blocks.en: On Harness-Bench, Gemini improves with each pass, but Qwen drops 4.06 points from its first-pass peak. Revisions can therefore sharpen useful guidance while also making it overly specific to recently observed evidence . Together, these results suggest that effective learning requires both continued refinement and selective retention. A practical update rule should use development-only evidence to assess confidence in revisions and decide whether to continue, retain an earlier version, or roll back.
blocks.zh: 在Harness-Bench上,双子座每通过一次都会有所改进,但Quen从它的首个通过峰降4.06分. 因此,修订可强化有用的指导,同时使之过于具体地针对最近观察到的证据。 这些结果表明,有效的学习需要不断改进和有选择地保留。 一项实际更新规则应当使用只发展的证据来评估对修订的信心,并决定是继续、保留更早的版本,还是回滚。

blocks.en: 5.2 Self-Improvement through Harness Design
blocks.zh: 5.2 通过利用设计自我改进

blocks.en: Meta-skills need not rely on a stronger external teacher: the same model can serve as both Builder and Target . We evaluate three settings using Gemini-3.6-Flash and Gemini-3.1-Pro, with construction, reflection, and execution performed by the same model within each case. This setting tests whether a model can use past execution experience to improve its own future performance through learned support design .
blocks.zh: Meta-技能不需要依赖更强大的外部老师:同样的模式可以同时充当构建者和目标. 我们使用双子座-3.6-Flash和双子座3.1-Pro来评价三个设置,每个情况下由同一个模型进行构造,反射和执行. 这种设置测试一个模型是否可以利用过去的执行经验,通过学习到的支持设计来提高自己的未来性能.

blocks.en: Across the three settings in Figure 3 (a), Builder meta-skills yield average gains of 18.71 points over no-skill construction and 14.14 points over skills delivered directly to the Target. These results identify an additional axis of optimization: improving how a model equips itself, without weight updates or a stronger teacher. This mechanism could complement the Target’s own skill learning: as the Target’s capabilities improve, the Builder could adapt its support to the Target’s changing needs, while execution feedback informs further support refinement. Self-evolution could therefore involve coordinated improvement in both task-solving capabilities and the environments that support them.
blocks.zh: 在图3(a)的三种情况下,建设者元技能的平均收益比无技能建筑高18.71分,比直接向目标提供的技能高14.14分。 这些结果确定了另一个优化轴线:改进一个模型如何装备自己,没有重量更新或更强大的老师. 这一机制可以补充目标本身的技能学习:随着目标能力提高,建设者可以调整其支助,以适应目标不断变化的需要,而执行反馈则有助于进一步改进支助。 因此,自我演变可能涉及协调改善完成任务的能力和支持这些能力的环境。

blocks.en: Figure 3 : (a) Same-model self-evolution compares no-skill construction, independent Target skills, and Builder meta-skills. Meta-skill bar labels show absolute scores and gains over no-skill construction. (b) Cross-Builder transfer on Harness-Bench and NewtonBench. Top: test scores without (outlined bars) and with (filled bars) Builder meta-skills. Bottom: paired gains in percentage points with 95% task-bootstrap confidence intervals; dashed lines indicate zero gain.

blocks.en: 5.3 Meta-Skill Transfer across Builders and Targets
blocks.zh: 5.3 跨越建筑商和目标的元技能转让

blocks.en: Meta-skills specify support principles while leaving implementation to the Builder . We test whether a learned bank remains useful when another Builder translates it into harnesses. All evaluations use Qwen-Flash as Target on the complete test splits of Harness-Bench and NewtonBench, comparing four settings: • Original Builder reuse: GPT-5.6-Sol learns from Qwen-Flash’s development executions and uses its own bank to construct test harnesses. • Transfer across Builders: Gemini-3.1-Pro constructs harnesses using the frozen Sol-to-Qwen bank, changing the Builder while holding the bank and Target fixed. • Recipient Builder learning: Gemini-3.1-Pro learns its own bank from Qwen-Flash’s development executions and uses it to construct test harnesses. • Transfer across Builders and Targets: Gemini-3.1-Pro receives a frozen bank learned by Sol from Gemini-3.6-Flash’s executions and constructs harnesses for Qwen-Flash, changing both the Builder and the Target relative to skill acquisition. Banks are learned on each benchmark’s development split and frozen before testing. Each receiving Builder uses the full bank to construct a fresh harness per test task. Figure 3 (b) reports scores and paired differences against contemporaneous no-skill runs of the same Builder.
blocks.zh: Meta技能指定了支持原则,同时将实施留给构建者。 我们测试当另一个建设者将其转化为工具时,一个有学问的银行是否仍然有用。 所有评价都使用Quen-Flash作为Harness-Bench和Newton Bench的完整测试分数的目标,比较了四个设置: • 原始构建器再利用:GPT-5.6-Sol从Quen-Flash的开发执行中吸取教训,并利用自己的银行来构建测试带. • 跨越建设者之间的转移:双子座3.1-Pro构型利用被冻结的Sol-to-Quen银行,在固定银行和目标时改变建设者。 · 接受者建设者学习:双子座3.1-Pro从Quen-Flash的开发处决中学习自己的银行,并利用它来建造测试工具。 · 跨越建设者与目标转移:双子座3.1-Pro接收了索尔从双子座-3.6-Flash的处决中得知的一家冻结的银行,并搭建了Quen-Flash的机床,改变了建设者和目标与技能获取的相对关系。 银行在测试前了解每个基准的开发情况。 每个接收的建设者都使用全库来构建每个测试任务的新鲜吊带. 图3 (b) 报告同一建构器同时无技能运行的分数和对数差异。
