blocks.zh: 接受者建设者学习:双子座-3.1-Pro从Quen-Flash的开发处决中学习自己的银行,并用它来构建测试工具.

blocks.en: Transfer across Builders and Targets: Gemini-3.1-Pro receives a frozen bank learned by Sol from Gemini-3.6-Flash’s executions and constructs harnesses for Qwen-Flash, changing both the Builder and the Target relative to skill acquisition.
blocks.zh: 跨越构建者与目标:双子座3.1-Pro接收了索尔从双子座-3.6-Flash处决中得知的冻结银行,并搭建了Quen-Flash的套路,改变了构建者和目标与技能获取的相对关系.

blocks.en: On NewtonBench, the Sol-to-Qwen bank yields a 13.36-point gain with Sol but a 4.45-point decline when transferred to Gemini-Pro; on Harness-Bench, the same transfer instead yields a 2.72-point gain. These results support the feasibility of cross-Builder reuse, although all confidence intervals include zero, leaving the performance benefits uncertain. The differing outcomes suggest that transfer depends partly on how the receiving Builder translates shared lessons into a harness : even the skill bank is fixed, different Builders may implement the same guidance differently. Refining the resulting harness through execution feedback may therefore help realize the value of transferred meta-skills.
blocks.zh: 在牛顿奔驰(Newton Bench)上,Sol-to-Quen银行与Sol取得13.36分的利润,但在转会至双子座-Pro时则出现4.45分的下降;在Harness-Bench上,同样的转会反而产生2.72分的利润. 这些结果支持跨构造再利用的可行性,尽管所有置信间隔都包含0,使得性能效益不确定. 不同的结果表明,转移部分取决于接收方的构建者如何将共享的教训转化为利用:即使技能库是固定的,不同的构建者也可能以不同的方式执行同样的指导. 因此,通过执行反馈改进由此产生的利用,可能有助于实现转移元技能的价值。

blocks.en: Gemini-Pro’s own bank outperforms the imported Sol-to-Qwen bank by 3.69 points on Harness-Bench and 9.93 points on NewtonBench, with positive gains over its no-skill controls on both benchmarks. This pattern suggests that learning from the recipient’s own harness executions still better align meta-skills with its implementation choices . Recipient-side learning may therefore complement cross-Builder reuse: imported skills provide reusable guidance, while feedback from the recipient’s harnesses offers a basis for refining that guidance.
blocks.zh: 双子公司自己的银行在Harness-Bench上比进口的Sol-to-Quen银行高3.69分,在Newton Bench上高9.93分,在这两个基准的无技能控制上都取得了积极收益。 这种模式表明,从接受者自身手中学习处决仍然更符合其执行选择。 因此,接受方的学习可以补充跨建筑的再利用:进口技能提供可重复使用的指导,而接受方的反馈为完善这种指导提供了基础。

blocks.en: Transferring Sol’s Gemini-derived bank to Gemini-Pro building harnesses for Qwen yields gains of 4.58 points on Harness-Bench and 5.48 points on NewtonBench. On NewtonBench, the transferred bank scores only 0.68 points below Gemini-Pro’s own Qwen-derived bank and even outperforms the imported Sol-to-Qwen bank, despite the latter matching the receiving Target. This pattern suggests that the relevance of learned support principles may matter more than an exact source-Target match : guidance learned for one Builder–Target pair can remain useful when another Builder implements it for a different Target .
blocks.zh: 将索尔的双子公司衍生的银行转移到双子公司大楼的昆文号牌上, 在牛顿奔驰(Newton Bench)上,转移银行的得分仅比双子座-Pro自己的Quen衍生银行低0.68分,甚至超过了进口的Sol-to-Quen银行,尽管后者符合接收目标. 这种模式表明,学到的支持原则的相关性可能比精确的源目标匹配更重要 : 当另一个构建者为不同的目标实施该目标时,为一个构建者-目标对所学到的指导仍然有用 。

blocks.en: Table 4: Harness component ablations on NewtonBench. We report test scores (%), changes (ablation minus full) using the main-table full-bank execution as the reference, and unadjusted 95% paired task-bootstrap confidence intervals for these changes. Intervals containing zero indicate uncertainty in the direction of the average effect.
blocks.zh: 表4:牛顿奔驰上的热量成分。 我们报告测试分数(%),使用主表全银行执行(full-bank)作为参考的改变(缩写减满),以及未经调整的95%的任务组合置信间隔。 含零的间隔表示平均效应方向的不确定性.

blocks.en: 5.4 Harness Component Ablations
blocks.zh: 5.4 利用性组件

blocks.en: Meta-skills affect execution through the harnesses the Builder creates. Using NewtonBench as a case study, we freeze the constructed harnesses and replay every test task after removing either the execution controller or memory plus context. Table 4 reports the average score difference between complete and ablated harnesses, with negative values favoring retention. The accompanying confidence intervals quantify uncertainty in this average effect across test tasks.
blocks.zh: Meta技能通过构建者创造的绳索影响执行. 使用牛顿奔驰作为案例研究,在移除了执行控制器或内存加上下文后,我们冻结了构造的牵引装置,并重放每一项测试任务. 表4报告全带和宽带的平均分数差异,负值倾向于保留。 伴随而来的置信间隔量化了整个试验任务中这种平均效应的不确定性。

blocks.en: Removing the controller lowers scores for all three Targets: by 13.36 points for Gemini, 4.79 for Qwen, and 1.03 for GPT-OSS. These consistent observed drops support the controller’s role in improving execution, although only Gemini’s confidence interval excludes zero. The size of the benefit varies with both Target behavior and controller design : each ablation isolates the controller within a frozen harness, but its functions may differ across Targets, including experiment sequencing, state tracking, or submission management. Effective harness design therefore uses external coordination where it helps, tailoring the controller’s functions to each Target’s execution needs.
blocks.zh: 删除控制器后将所有三个目标的分数降低:双子座13.36分,Quen4.79分,GPT-OSS1.03分. 这些一致的观测下降支持控制器在改进执行方面的作用,尽管只有双子座的置信间隔排除0. 好处的大小随目标行为和控制器设计而异:每次衰减都会将控制器隔离在一个被冻结的吊带内,但其功能可能因目标而异,包括实验测序,状态跟踪,或提交管理. 因此,有效的驾驭设计利用外部协调,使控制者的职能适应每个目标的执行需要。

blocks.en: Retaining memory plus context yields small positive estimated effects for Gemini and Qwen and a negative effect for GPT-OSS, although all three confidence intervals contain zero. These estimates suggest potential benefits for some Targets, but do not establish a reliable aggregate effect. Additional state can preserve useful evidence, while its value depends on keeping that evidence relevant and avoiding redundant or outdated information. Meta-skills therefore should support selective state exposure by guiding what to retain and when to surface it for the Target .
blocks.zh: 保留记忆加上下文对双子座和Quen产生微小的正面估计效果,对GPT-OSS产生负效应,尽管所有三个置信间隔都包含零. 这些估计表明,一些目标可能受益,但没有确定可靠的总效应。 附加状态可以保存有用的证据,而其价值取决于保留相关证据和避免多余或过时的信息. 因此,元技术应支持选择性的状态接触,指导如何保留以及何时为目标表面。

blocks.en: 5.5 Outcome Transitions and Error Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.5 结果过渡和错误分析

blocks.en: Aggregate scores can conceal both changes in execution outcomes and offsetting gains and regressions across task families. We pair the full-bank meta-skill and no-skill Builders on all model–task pairs across the six main-study settings. In Figure 4 , panel (a) aggregates outcome transitions across the three Targets within each benchmark, showing which outcomes are rescued or degraded, while panel (b) breaks down paired score differences by Harness-Bench task category and NewtonBench physical mechanism for each Target, revealing where improvements concentrate and where failures persist.
blocks.zh: 合计分数既可以掩盖执行结果的变化,也可以掩盖各个任务领域的收益和倒退。 我们把全库的元技能建设者和无技能建设者配对到所有模型-任务组合上, 在图4中,小组(a) 汇总每个基准内三个目标之间的结果过渡,显示哪些结果得到挽救或退化,小组(b) 按Harness-Bench任务类别和Newton Bench物理机制对每个目标进行对等分差的细分,揭示改进集中之处和失败持续存在之处。

blocks.en: On NewtonBench, cases with no valid submission fall from 394 to 254 (35.5%), while correct discoveries rise from 439 to 535 (21.9%). Transitions include 145 recoveries from no valid submission to a correct law, versus 46 regressions. This suggests more reliable completion of the scientific loop, creating opportunities for correct discovery. Valid-but-incorrect submissions also rise from 43 to 87, showing that completion enables but does not guarantee correctness. On Harness-Bench, full successes increase from 59 to 67, largely through transitions from partial to full success. This suggests that meta-skills help agents satisfy remaining requirements and turn partial progress into complete task fulfillment .
blocks.zh: 在牛顿奔驰,没有有效呈报的病例从394例下降到254例(35.5%),而正确的发现则从439例上升到535例(21.9%). 过渡包括145项追偿,从没有向正确的法律提交有效追偿,而46项追偿。 这表明科学循环的完成更加可靠,为正确的发现创造了机会. 有效但不正确的提交书也从43件增加到87件,表明完成可以但不能保证正确。 在Harness-Bench上,全部成功从59次增加到67次,主要是通过从局部成功过渡到完全成功. 这说明,元技能可以帮助代理人满足其余要求,将部分进展转化为全面完成任务。

blocks.en: All three Targets improve overall on NewtonBench by 6.85–13.36 points, with positive category-level point estimates for gravity, radioactive decay, and Hooke’s law across models. Harness-Bench shows gains for every Target on SRE/release tasks, with mixed effects elsewhere. GPT-OSS improves by 5.20 points overall but declines by 2.23 points on vertical workflows, illustrating that a positive aggregate gain can coexist with category-specific regressions. These recurring gains suggest shared support needs across models, while the remaining variation points to the importance of Target–task compatibility. This further motivates reusing support principles while adapting their implementation to each Target’s capabilities and the task’s demands.
blocks.zh: 所有三个目标在牛顿奔驰上总体上都改进了6.85–13.36分,对重力,放射性衰变和Hooke的定律进行了正面的类别级点估计. Harness-Bench在SRE/释放任务的每个目标上都显示出收益,在其他地方效果好坏参半. GPT-OSS总体上提高了5.20个百分点,但在纵向工作流程上下降了2.23个百分点,说明正的合计收益可以与特定类别的回归共存。 这些反复出现的成果表明,各个模型都有共同的支助需求,而其余的变异则表明目标任务兼容的重要性。 这进一步促使人们重新利用支助原则,同时使这些原则的实施适应每个目标的能力和任务的要求。

blocks.en: Figure 4 : (a) Outcome transitions from no-skill to full-bank meta-skill Builders, aggregated over three Targets. Band widths represent paired-task counts; in-band numbers highlight the largest cross-outcome flows. “Zero” includes zero scores and construction failures; “Invalid” includes missing or unparsable submissions and construction failures. (b) Category-level effects across all six settings. Rows represent Harness-Bench task categories and NewtonBench physical mechanisms; columns represent Targets. Bars show score differences between full-bank and no-skill Builders with unadjusted 95% task-bootstrap confidence intervals. Purple dashed lines indicate setting’s overall effect.
blocks.zh: 图4:(a) 从无技能者向全库元技能建设者的成果过渡,总数超过三个目标。 带宽代表配对任务计数;带内数字突出显示最大跨结果流. “零”包括零分和施工故障;“无效”包括缺失或无法解析的提交和施工故障。 (b) 所有六种设置的类别级别影响。 行代表Harness-Bench任务类别和牛顿Bench物理机制;列代表目标. 横杠显示全银行和无技能建设者之间的得分差异,任务波纹置信间隔未调整95%. 紫色破折线表示环境的总体效果。

blocks.en: 6 Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6. 讨论和结论

blocks.en: With semantic knowledge held fixed, Builder enactment gains 12.02 points over direct delivery on average. This suggests that experience becomes useful through decisions about which burdens to externalize as state, tools, or control. Meta-skills guide these decisions, helping Builders allocate support so that Targets can devote their limited interaction budgets to the remaining judgment.
blocks.zh: 随着语义知识的掌握得到固定,建筑师的颁布平均比直接交付提高了12.02分。 这表明,通过决定国家、工具或控制外部化的负担,经验变得有用。 Meta技能指导这些决定,帮助构建者分配支持,以便目标将有限的互动预算用于剩余判断.

blocks.en: Observed gains across Builders and Targets suggest that support principles can generalize across models, while variable effects indicate that their implementation matters. Stronger observed performance from recipient-learned banks further motivates adapting transferred guidance. Future systems could preserve a skill’s support intent while using recipient-side feedback to refine what information to store, which tools to provide, and when to intervene.
blocks.zh: 在整个建设者和目标组织中观察到的成果表明,支助原则可以泛泛于各种模型中,而可变效果则表明其执行很重要。 受援国吸收银行观察到的更佳业绩进一步促使调整转移指导。 未来的系统可以保留技能的支持意图,同时利用接受方的反馈来完善存储哪些信息、提供何种工具和何时进行干预。

blocks.en: Same-model studies show that a model can improve its own test-time execution by learning to construct better harnesses, while its weights remain fixed. Our evidence spans one main Builder, two benchmarks, and one adopted execution per task and condition. Establishing broader applicability requires more diverse Builders and tasks, and evaluation of performance gains relative to construction cost, which we leave to future works.
blocks.zh: 同型模型的研究表明,一个模型可以通过学习建造更好的吊带来改进自己的测试时间执行,而其重量则保持不变. 我们的证据涉及一个主要的建设者,两个基准,一个是通过每项任务和条件的执行。 建立更广泛的适用性需要更加多样化的建筑商和任务,以及评价相对于建筑成本的绩效收益,我们留给未来工程。

blocks.en: In this work, we introduced meta-skill that enable a Builder to learn reusable support principles from the execution outcomes of its own harnesses and implement them for unseen tasks. With both models’ weights fixed, full-bank meta-skills improve macro-average performance across Harness-Bench and NewtonBench by 8.95 percentage points over no-skill construction and 12.02 points over direct delivery of the same bank to the Target. These comparisons highlight the value of translating experience into executable support: a lesson can guide the construction of tools, state, and control mechanisms that help the Target apply its capabilities during execution. Outcome analyses connect these gains to more reliable task completion, while component and transfer results point to the importance of adapting reusable principles to each model and task. Same-model experiments further demonstrate that a model can self-improve by learning to build better support for itself. Together, these findings identify support design as a complementary axis of agent improvement.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们引入了元技能,使建设者能够从自身执行成果中学习可再利用的支助原则,并将其用于无形的任务。 随着两个模型的权重固定,全银行元技能在Harness-Bench和Newton Bench的宏观平均表现在无技能建筑上提高了8.95个百分点,在直接向目标交付同一银行上提高了12.02个百分点。 这些比较凸显了将经验转化为可执行支持的价值:一个教训可以指导构建工具,状态,以及控制机制,帮助目标在执行过程中应用其能力. 结果分析将这些成果与更可靠的任务完成联系起来,而组成部分和转让结果则表明,必须使可重复使用的原则适应每个模式和任务。 同型模型实验进一步证明,一个模型可以通过学习建立更好的自我支持来自我改进. 这些结论共同确定支助设计是改进代理人的一个补充轴心。

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: This work studies automated harness design using existing agent-workflow and simulated scientific-discovery benchmarks. Experiments use isolated execution environments and bounded resources, with development and test tasks separated and meta-skill banks frozen before evaluation to preserve evaluation integrity. Because generated tools and controllers can enable unintended or harmful actions, applications beyond these benchmarks should incorporate restricted permissions, validation of generated components, and human oversight appropriate to the application.
blocks.zh: 这项工作利用现有的代理-工作流程和模拟科学发现基准,研究自动化的牵引设计。 实验利用孤立的执行环境和限定的资源,开发与测试任务分离,元技能库在评价前冻结,以维护评价的完整性. 由于生成的工具和控制器能够促成意外或有害的行动,超出这些基准的应用程序应包含限制权限、验证生成的组件以及适合应用程序的人力监督。

blocks.en: Appendix
blocks.zh: 附 录

blocks.en: Appendix A Significance, Scope, and Clarifications
blocks.zh: 意义、范围和澄清

blocks.en: A.1 Why Builder Learning Matters
blocks.zh: A.1 为什么建设者学习问题

blocks.en: We discuss the significance of Builder learning and highlight the core contributions of this study.
blocks.zh: 我们讨论建设者学习的重要性,并强调这项研究的核心贡献。

blocks.en: Learning to Design Useful Support. We study how a Builder can turn experience into reusable principles for supporting (or harnessing) a Target. These meta-skills specify when support is needed, what to provide, and how the Target should use it. They guide fresh harness construction on subsequent tasks, allowing the Builder to carry forward design knowledge while adapting its implementation to each task. This makes support design itself an object of learning.
blocks.zh: 学习设计实用支持. 我们研究建设者如何将经验转化为支持(或利用)目标可重复使用的原则。 这些元技能具体规定了何时需要支助、应提供什么以及目标应如何使用。 它们指导对后续任务进行新利用的建设,使建设者能够推进设计知识,同时使其实施适应每项任务. 这使得支持设计本身成为学习的对象.

blocks.en: Turning Experience into Executable Support. In the main study, giving the full skill bank to the Builder yields higher scores than giving the same bank directly to the Target in all six settings. This highlights the value of translating guidance into tools, state, and execution control that the Target can use. The same-model experiments further illustrate a route to system-level self-improvement: a model can use execution experience to learn how to equip itself more effectively, with its weights unchanged.
blocks.zh: 将经验转化为可执行支持。 在主要研究中,让建设者掌握全部技能的银行得到的分数高于在所有六个环境下直接给同一银行给目标. 这凸显了将指导转化为目标可以使用的工具、状态和执行控制的价值。 同型实验进一步说明了系统层面自我改进的途径:一个模型可以利用执行经验学习如何更有效地装备自己,其重量不变.

blocks.en: A.2 Clarifications of Results
blocks.zh: A.2 对结果的澄清

blocks.en: We explain the rationale for our experimental settings and clarify the conclusions supported by our results.
blocks.zh: 我们解释我们实验环境的理由,并澄清我们的结果所支持的结论。

blocks.en: Contribution within test-time AI4AI. We study how experience improves a Builder’s ability to support a Target while both models’ weights remain fixed. Closely related work learns solver guidance, as in Evo-Harness [ 9 ] ; searches executable harness implementations, as in Meta-Harness [ 3 ] ; or evolves strategies for engineering context files and code, as in Meta Context Engineering [ 13 ] . Our focus is reusable knowledge for support design: the Builder extracts principles from its own harness outcomes, specifying when support is needed, what to provide, and how the Target should use it. These principles subsequently guide fresh construction for held-out tasks. Our contribution combines this learning and deployment protocol with controlled evidence on the value of accumulated Builder experience and its implementation as task-specific support.
blocks.zh: 在试验期间作出贡献。 我们研究经验如何提高建设者支持目标的能力,而两种模型的权重保持不变。 密切相关的工作学习解析器指导,如Evo-Harness [9];搜索可执行的带执行,如Meta-Harness [3];或演化工程上下文文件和代码的战略,如Meta上下文工程[13]. 我们的重点是为支助设计再利用知识:建设者从自己的利用成果中提取原则,具体说明何时需要支助,提供什么,以及目标应如何利用。 这些原则随后指导了被搁置任务的新建设。 我们的贡献将这一学习和部署程序与关于积累的建设者经验的价值及其执行作为具体任务支助的可控证据结合起来。

blocks.en: Shared framework and interpretation of the comparisons. All Builder conditions share component interfaces, design guidance, construction permissions, and bounded repair opportunities. The no-skill Builder assesses the additional value of learned guidance under the same construction allowance. Direct-bank baselines preserve the skill content and assess the benefit of having a Builder implement it before execution, while independently learned Target skills and mined notes provide alternative routes for applying experience to task solving. Full-bank macro-average gains of 8.95 points over no-skill construction and 12.02 points over direct delivery support the value of learning and implementing support principles within this framework. These comparisons fix Target execution limits; learning and construction fall outside those limits, with construction allowances matched across Builder conditions. Frozen-harness ablations examine component contributions within the resulting implementations, and case studies illustrate how principles become executable support. Their Target-dependent results, including the clear controller benefit for Gemini-3.6-Flash, support adapting available components to the recipient’s needs.
blocks.zh: 比较的共同框架和解释。 所有构建者条件共享组件接口,设计指导,施工权限,以及限定的修复机会. 无技能建设者根据同样的建筑津贴评估所学指导的额外价值。 直接银行基线保存技能内容,评估建设者在执行前实施这些内容的好处,同时独立学习目标技能和布雷说明为应用经验完成任务提供了替代途径。 全库宏观平均收益8.95分高于无技能建设,12.02分高于直接交付,支持本框架内学习和落实支持原则的价值. 这些比较确定了目标执行限度;学习和建造超出了这些限度,建筑津贴与建筑商的条件相匹配。 冻伤症检查了执行过程中的构成部分贡献,个案研究说明了原则如何成为可执行的支持。 其成果取决于目标,包括双子座-3.6-Flash的明确控制者利益,支持根据接受方的需要调整现有组件。

blocks.en: Evaluation protocol and reproducibility. Skill acquisition uses development episodes, and the bank is frozen before testing. Each test harness is constructed from the public task input and the supplied bank, without access to test execution feedback or reference answers. Appendices B and C document the core settings: the partitioning procedure, information access, model choices, resource limits, baseline configurations, failure accounting, and paired task-bootstrap procedures. All declared test tasks remain in the evaluation denominator, and reported intervals characterize uncertainty across paired test instances. Upon paper acceptance, we will release the full code and all prompts for skill learning, harness construction, baseline runs, and evaluation, together with the experimental configurations.
blocks.zh: 评价协议和可复制性。 技能收购使用开发事件,银行在测试前被冻结. 每个测试工具都是通过公共任务输入和提供库构建的,无法获取测试执行反馈或参考答案. 附录B和C记录核心设置:分区程序、信息获取、模型选择、资源限制、基线配置、故障核算和对任务组合程序。 所有申报的试验任务都留在评价分母中,所报告的间隔是成对试验中不确定性的特点。 在接受纸张后,我们将发布完整的代码和所有提示,用于技能学习、利用构造、基线运行和评价,以及实验配置。

blocks.en: Generalization to new tasks within each benchmark. Banks learned from approximately 10% of each benchmark guide construction on the remaining held-out instances, with full-bank improvements over no-skill construction in all six settings. This establishes the usefulness of accumulated experience for new tasks within known categories and mechanisms, covering both workflow execution and scientific discovery. Cross-dataset reuse is a natural extension beyond this evaluation scope and is left to future work. A promising hypothesis is that skill granularity is central to broader reuse: principles should specify recurring support needs precisely enough to guide construction while leaving their implementation adaptable. Separating support principles from executable realizations provides a concrete basis for studying this balance.
blocks.zh: 概括到每个基准内的新任务。 银行从每个基准建筑中大约10%的剩余被搁置情况中汲取了教训,在所有六个环境中,银行全面改进了无技能建筑。 这确立了积累的经验对于已知类别和机制内的新任务的效用,既包括工作流程执行,也包括科学发现. 跨数据集再利用是超越本评价范围的自然延伸,留待未来工作处理. 一个很有希望的假设是,技能颗粒性是更广泛的再利用的核心:原则应明确规定经常性的支助需求,以便精确地指导建设,同时使实施工作具有适应性。 把支持原则与可执行的实现分开,为研究这种平衡提供了具体的基础。

blocks.en: Transfer as reuse across Builder–Target configurations. Our transfer study examines reuse of a frozen bank when the Builder or the Builder–Target pair changes. Effects are measured against concurrent no-skill runs of the receiving Builder and interpreted through paired confidence intervals. Cross-Builder-and-Target transfer yields positive point estimates on both benchmarks, illustrating promising reuse across selected model combinations. The broader results establish the feasibility of sharing principles while showing that their realized utility depends on the receiving configuration, with performance benefits qualified by the reported uncertainty. Recipient-side learning offers a complementary route for aligning support principles with a Builder’s own implementations.
blocks.zh: 通过 Builder - 目标配置进行再利用。 我们的转移研究研究了当构建者或构建者-目标对换时冷冻库的再利用。 影响是根据接收者同时进行的无技能运动来衡量的,并通过对置信间隔加以解释。 跨建材和目标转让对两个基准都产生正点估计,说明在选定的模型组合中有希望再利用。 更广泛的结果确立了分享原则的可行性,同时表明这些原则的效用取决于接收的配置,而业绩效益则取决于报告的不确定性。 接受方学习为使支助原则与建设者自己的执行相一致提供了一条补充途径。

blocks.en: A simple foundation for meta-skill evolution. We adopt a simple initial evolution mechanism to make the contribution of experience directly assessable. Starting from an empty bank, the Builder constructs harnesses, reviews Target execution, and makes one evidence-grounded decision per development task: keep, revise, or add. Two development passes produce the bank used for evaluation. Held-out gains demonstrate that useful support principles can emerge through this lightweight procedure, while same-model experiments extend the result to self-improvement without a stronger external teacher. The refinement curves show that update effects depend on the Target and task, motivating future advances in selective revision and retention on top of this working foundation.
blocks.zh: 元技能进化的简单基础. 我们采用了一个简单的初步演变机制,以便直接评估经验的贡献。 从一个空库开始,建设者构建利用,审查目标执行,并作出一项基于证据的决定:保留、修改或添加每项发展任务。 两份发展通行证产生用于评价的银行。 被搁置的成果表明,可以通过这种轻量级程序产生有用的支持原则,而同一种模式的实验则将结果扩大到没有更强大的外部教师的自我改进。 完善曲线显示,更新效果取决于目标和任务,激励今后在这一工作基础上进行有选择的修订和保留。

blocks.en: A.3 Scope and Future Directions
blocks.zh: A.3 范围和未来方向

blocks.en: We define the scope of the present study and identify promising directions for future research that build on its findings.
blocks.zh: 我们界定了本研究的范围,并确定了今后在研究结果基础上进行研究的有希望的方向。

blocks.en: Support design as the object of learning. This work studies learning that changes the knowledge and execution environments surrounding fixed models. The reported improvements therefore concern the resulting Builder–Target system, including system-level self-improvement when the same model serves both roles. The meta-skill representation and component interfaces provide a concrete instantiation of this learning problem within a shared design space. Our contribution establishes the usefulness of this route under the evaluated conditions and provides a reference point for studying alternative support representations and construction policies. A complementary direction is to combine Builder learning with improvements to the Target itself, allowing task-solving capabilities and the support that makes them effective to develop together.
blocks.zh: 支持设计作为学习对象. 这项工作研究学习如何改变围绕固定模型的知识和执行环境。 因此,所报告的改进涉及由此产生的建设者目标系统,包括在同一模式同时发挥双重作用时的系统一级自我改进。 元技能表达和组件接口在共享设计空间内为这个学习问题提供了具体的即时反应. 我们的贡献确定了这一途径在评估条件下的效用,并为研究替代支助说明和建筑政策提供了一个参考点。 一个相辅相成的方向是,将建设者学习与改进目标本身结合起来,使完成任务的能力和支持能够有效地共同发展。

blocks.en: Empirical scope and explanatory claims. We evaluate end-to-end task performance, encompassing both benchmark correctness and the execution processes needed to achieve it. Preserving evidence, validating artifacts, and reaching a valid submission are substantive parts of this objective. The empirical effects are conditional on the evaluated task inventories, models, learned banks, and recorded executions. Component analyses examine contributions within the generated harnesses, while case studies illustrate concrete ways in which support changes execution. These findings provide an empirical basis for further work on stability and mechanism: independent learning runs, repeated executions, and alternative task partitions can characterize variability across experience histories, and targeted interventions on individual principles and component interactions can refine the causal account of how support helps.
blocks.zh: 经验范围和解释性索赔。 我们评价从端到端的任务执行情况,包括基准正确性以及实现这一目标所需的执行程序。 保存证据、验证文物和提交有效材料是这一目标的实质性部分。 经验效应取决于评估的任务清单、模型、学习银行和记录的处决。 组成部分分析审查所产生工具内的贡献,个案研究则说明支持变革执行的具体方式。 这些调查结果为在稳定和机制方面进一步开展工作提供了经验基础:独立学习、重复处决和替代性任务分配可说明不同经验历史的可变性,针对个别原则和组成部分互动的干预措施可改进支助如何帮助的因果关系。

blocks.en: Generality through shared support needs. The main generalization claim concerns new instances within known workflow categories and physical mechanisms; the model-transfer studies provide exploratory evidence for selected receiving configurations. Extending reuse across datasets, unseen task families, and different tool interfaces is a promising next step. One hypothesis is that the scope of a principle depends strongly on the granularity at which it describes a support need. For example, preserving evidence after a tool failure may be useful across domains even when the appropriate storage and recovery mechanisms differ. Studying this separation between a reusable need and its local implementation could clarify when principles transfer directly, when recipient-side adaptation helps, and how to learn banks that serve broader collections of tasks.
blocks.zh: 通过共同支助需求实现普遍化。 主要的一般索赔涉及已知工作流程类别和物理机制内的新情况;模型转移研究为选定的接收配置提供了探索性证据。 将重复使用扩展到数据集、隐形任务家族和不同的工具界面,是有希望的下一步。 一个假设是,一项原则的范围在很大程度上取决于它描述支持需要的颗粒性。 例如,在工具故障后保存证据,即使在适当的储存和回收机制不同的情况下,在各个领域都可能是有用的。 研究可重复使用的需求与地方实施之间的这种区分,可以澄清原则何时直接转让,何时接受方适应帮助,以及如何学习为更广泛的任务集服务的银行。

blocks.en: Evolution over longer learning histories. The current two-pass development procedure followed by frozen-bank deployment demonstrates that a bounded amount of experience can improve subsequent harness construction. Extending this setting to longer task streams would allow study of how useful principles are retained, revised, and combined as experience accumulates. The observed variation between refinement passes motivates development-based assessment of candidate updates and selective retention of successful guidance. Larger banks also create opportunities for adaptive retrieval and skill composition, extending the current comparison of full-bank access and BM25 top-2 retrieval. These directions would develop the present initial mechanism into a learning process suited to longer histories and changing support needs.
blocks.zh: 进化超越了漫长的学习历史. 目前的双通道开发程序以及冻结的银行部署表明,有限的经验可以改进以后的利用工程。 将这一框架扩大到较长的任务流程,将使人们能够研究随着经验积累,如何保留、修订和综合有益的原则。 所观察到的完善通行证之间的差异促使对候选人最新情况进行基于发展的评估和有选择地保留成功的指导。 较大的银行也创造了适应性检索和技能构成的机会,扩展了目前对全银行存取和BM25顶-2检索的比较. 这些方向将发展目前的初始机制,使其成为适合较长历史和不断变化的支助需求的学习过程。

blocks.en: Performance objectives and deployment conditions. The experiments study performance under fixed Target interaction limits, with Builder learning and construction providing support outside that execution budget. This setting makes the value of prepared support assessable for a given Target operating under the same interaction constraints. The supported performance claim uses this budget definition. For deployment, a complementary objective is to allocate a joint compute or latency budget across learning, construction, and execution according to the workload. Future work can study how reuse of learned banks, caching of common support components, and task-adaptive construction effort affect this allocation, connecting the demonstrated performance benefits to different deployment requirements.
blocks.zh: 业绩目标和部署条件。 实验在固定的目标交互限度下研究性能,由Builder学习和建筑在那个执行预算之外提供支持. 这种设定使得准备的支持值可以评估在相同互动制约下运行的特定目标。 支持的履约索赔采用了这一预算定义。 就部署而言,一个补充目标是根据工作量分配一个在学习、建筑和执行方面的联合计算或长期预算。 今后的工作可以研究重新利用知识库、缓存共同支助部件以及适应任务的建造工作如何影响这一分配,将已显示的业绩效益与不同的部署要求联系起来。

blocks.en: Appendix B Reproducibility Details
blocks.zh: 附录B 可复制 细节

blocks.en: B.1 Data partitions and information access
blocks.zh: B.1 数据分区和信息存取

blocks.en: For each benchmark, we reserve a development set of approximately 10% of the instances for meta-skill learning and use the remainder for testing. We determine the development-set size by rounding ten percent of the total to the nearest integer, with ties rounded up, and allocate proportional integer quotas across the public Harness-Bench categories and NewtonBench domains. This partitioning evaluates generalization to held-out instances within known categories and mechanisms. We use no separate validation partition, and the learned skill bank is frozen before testing, with no revisions based on test outcomes.
blocks.zh: 对于每个基准,我们保留一套大约10%的元技能学习实例,并将其余实例用于测试。 我们确定开发设定的大小, 将总量的百分之十四舍五入到最接近的整数, 将联系四舍五入, 在公共的Harness-Bench类别和牛顿Bench域中分配比例整数配额。 这种划分评估了已知类别和机制内被搁置的事例的一般情况。 我们没有使用单独的验证分区,学习的技能库在测试前被冻结,没有根据测试结果进行修改.

blocks.en: Each meta-skill contains when , provide , and use fields, with a combined limit of 192 tokens. During learning, the Builder receives the entire current bank and updates it using evidence from learning episodes. The actual submission, or its absence, serves as the primary evidence, interpreted alongside the public task requirements, complete input–observation pairs, public errors, final artifacts, and support delivered by the harness. Each update produces a single decision: keep the bank unchanged, revise an existing skill, or add a new skill. A revision must identify the existing skill and the current evidence motivating the change; superseded versions remain archived. Neither private reference answers nor researcher-written diagnoses are provided during this process.
blocks.zh: 每个元技能包含: ,提供,并使用字段,综合限制为192个令牌. 在学习期间,构建者接收整个当前银行,并利用学习事件的证据进行更新. 实际提交或未提交是主要证据,与公共任务要求一起解释,完整的输入-观察对、公开错误、最后的文物以及吊带所提供的支持。 每次更新都会产生一个单一的决定:保持银行不变,修改现有的技能,或者增加新的技能. 修订必须确定现有技能和目前推动变革的证据;被取代的版本仍然存档。 在这一过程中,既未提供私人参考答复,也未提供研究人员撰写的诊断。

blocks.en: At deployment, BM25 queries the skill bank using only the initial public task prompt and retrieves at most two skills with positive match scores. Harness construction receives the public initial task, neutral component interfaces, and the assigned semantic skill pack. The Builder has no access to test trajectories, scores, reference answers, or evaluator internals, so construction depends entirely on the information available before Target execution.
blocks.zh: 在部署时,BM25只使用初始的公共任务即时查询技能库,并最多检索两个有正比分的技能. Harness建筑接收公共初始任务,中性组件接口,以及分配的语义技能包. 构建者无法获取测试轨迹,分数,参考答案,或评估内部,因此构建完全取决于目标执行前可获得的信息.

blocks.en: B.2 Models and resource limits
blocks.zh: B.2 模式和资源限度

blocks.en: We use GPT-5.6-Sol as the Builder for both harness construction and meta-skill updates. The Target models are Gemini-3.6-Flash, Qwen3.8-Flash, and GPT-OSS-120B. All requests specify a temperature of zero and request high reasoning effort.
blocks.zh: 我们使用GPT-5.6-Sol作为制动器,既用于牵引构造,也用于元技能更新. 目标型号为双子座-3.6-Flash,Qune3.8-Flash,以及GPT-OSS-120B. 所有请求都指定了0的温度,并请求高推理努力.

blocks.en: Harness construction allows up to 16K output tokens, with at most two repair attempts for candidates that violate the component interfaces. Each skill-update call allows up to 8K output tokens and returns the single keep, revise, or add decision described above. Target execution follows the benchmark-specific resource allowances listed below; these allowances are identical across experiment settings.
blocks.zh: Harness Building最多允许16K输出令牌,最多可以两次尝试对违反组件接口的候选人进行修复. 每次技能更新调用可允许最多8K输出令牌,并返回上述单项保存,修改或添加决定. 目标执行遵循以下所列的具体基准资源津贴;这些津贴在各种试验环境中是相同的。

blocks.en: Table 5: Per-task Target limits. Each model call permits at most 16,384 output tokens; NewtonBench additionally limits one experiment call to 20 queried items. Limits are identical across conditions within a setting.
blocks.zh: 表5:每个任务的目标限制。 每个型号的调用最多允许16,384个输出令牌;牛顿奔驰还额外限制一个实验调用20个被询问的项目. 在一个背景下,各种条件的限制是相同的。

blocks.en: B.3 Outcome and uncertainty accounting
blocks.zh: B.3 结果和不确定性核算

blocks.en: All reported aggregates use a fixed denominator containing every declared test task. When a run yields a valid native benchmark score, we retain that score, including zero. When construction or execution fails to yield a valid result, the task contributes zero to the system-level aggregate. This rule covers missing source bindings, infrastructure failures, and unresolved technical outcomes. The Builder and Target may attempt repairs within their permitted limits, but a run that remains unsuccessful or exceeds its total budget is still counted as zero. Thus, the absence of a native score never removes a task from the reported denominator.
blocks.zh: 所有报告的总量都使用包含每个申报测试任务的固定分母. 当运行产生有效的本土基准分数时,我们保留该分数,包括0分. 当构建或执行未能产生有效结果时,任务对系统级聚合的贡献为0. 这一规则涵盖缺失的源约束、基础设施故障以及尚未解决的技术结果。 建造者和目标可能试图在其允许的限度内进行修理,但运行失败或超过其总预算的,仍算为零。 因此,没有原生分数并不能消除报告分母中的任务。

blocks.en: For paired comparisons, we resample test tasks 20K times while preserving the pairing between conditions. We report the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles as unadjusted 95% intervals. These intervals describe variation across tasks in the fixed test inventory, rather than variability across repeated stochastic model generations.
blocks.zh: 对于配对比较,在保留条件之间的配对的同时,我们再做20K次测试任务. 我们报告2.5和97.5的百分位数 是未调整的95%的间隔。 这些间隔描述的是固定测试盘点中不同任务的差异,而不是重复的有条理的模型代的可变性.

blocks.en: Component ablations operate directly on frozen harnesses: we remove one component family without rebuilding the remaining support. Each paired contrast therefore measures the effect of that intervention on the recorded harness, conditional on a single official execution per task. For transfer experiments, paired comparisons use only the concurrent no-skill control from the same campaign. Differences across campaigns are reported only descriptively.
blocks.zh: 组件直接用冷冻的绳子操作:我们删除一个组件的家庭,而不重建剩余的支助。 因此,每个对齐的对比度量这种干预对记录的利用的影响,条件是每项任务只进行一次正式执行。 对于转移实验,配对比较只使用同一活动同时产生的无技能控制。 不同运动之间的差异仅以描述方式报告。

blocks.en: Appendix C Baseline configurations and interpretation
blocks.zh: 基准配置和解释

blocks.en: All conditions share the same development/test splits and per-task Target execution limits. We use GPT-5.6-Sol for both harness construction and skill extraction, with Gemini-3.6-Flash, Qwen3.8-Flash, and GPT-OSS-120B as Targets. We keep all the learned banks and notes frozen before testing.
blocks.zh: 所有条件都具有相同的开发/测试分割和每个任务的目标执行限制. 我们使用GPT-5.6-Sol进行牵引构造和技能提取,双子座-3.6-Flash,Qune3.8-Flash,以及GPT-OSS-120B作为目标. 在测试前我们把所有有学问的银行和纸币冻结起来

blocks.en: Retrieved versus full-bank access. These variants use the same learned content and differ only in how much of it is supplied at deployment. Full-bank access provides every learned skill, whereas retrieval uses the initial public task prompt as a BM25 query ( k 1 = 1.5 k_{1}=1.5 , b = 0.75 b=0.75 ) and selects at most two positive-scoring matches. If no skill receives a positive score, the resulting pack is empty. For free-form trajectory-mined notes, retrieval operates on natural paragraphs, while full-text access provides the complete notes. Holding the learned content fixed allows this comparison to assess selective versus comprehensive delivery without changing the learning procedure.
blocks.zh: 检索对全银行的访问. 这些变体使用相同的学习内容,只在部署时提供多少不同. Full-bank access提供每一个学习到的技能,而检索则使用初始的公共任务即时作为BM25查询(k 1 = 1.5 k_{1}=1.5,b = 0.75 b = 0.75),最多选择两个正评比. 如果没有技能获得正比分,结果的包是空的. 对于自由格式的轨迹最小音符,检索在自然段落上运行,而全文访问则提供完整的音符. 将学习内容固定下来,就可以进行这种比较,在不改变学习程序的情况下,评估选择性交付与全面交付。

blocks.en: Native environment. The Target executes directly in the shared neutral environment H 0 H_{0} , using native tools, default conversation history, and scratch storage. It receives no learned guidance or Builder-generated components, although it may create its own working aids through the available tools. This baseline represents ordinary task solving in the Target’s native environment and provides the reference point for evaluating additional support. Gains from our method over this setting therefore reflect the combined contribution of harness construction and learned meta-skills.
blocks.zh: 本土环境. 该目标在共享中性环境H 0 H_{0}中直接执行,使用本地工具,默认的对话历史,以及抓取存储. 虽然它可以通过现有工具创建自己的工作辅助工具,但是它没有得到任何学到的指导或构建器生成的组件。 这一基线代表了在目标所在的本土环境中解决的普通任务,并为评价额外支助提供了参考点。 因此,我们在这一背景下采用的方法所产生的收益反映了利用技术的建设和学到的元技能的综合贡献。

blocks.en: No-skill Builder. To separate the contribution of construction from that of learned experience, GPT-5.6-Sol constructs a fresh harness for each public task using an empty skill pack. The Builder otherwise retains the same seven component families, construction instructions, and information about the Target as our method, together with the same allowance of 16K output tokens and at most two interface-repair attempts. This baseline preserves the Builder’s ability to design support while removing access to learned meta-skills. For Gemini on Harness-Bench, performance increases from 37.35 in the native environment to 53.29 with no-skill construction, and then to 67.81 with our method. The first improvement captures the benefit of construction alone; the second captures the additional benefit of learned experience under the same construction interface.
blocks.zh: 无技能建设者. 为了将建筑的贡献与积累的经验区分开来,GPT-5.6-Sol利用空的成套技能,为每一项公共任务建造了一套新的技术。 否则,建筑师保留了与我们的方法相同的7个组成部分家庭、施工指示和关于目标的信息,同时保留了16K输出符的同等允许量,最多还保留了两次界面修复尝试。 这个基线保留了构建者设计支持的能力,同时取消了对学到的元技能的获取. 对于Harness-Bench上的双子座,性能从本土环境的37.35提高到53.29,无技能建筑,然后用我们的方法提高到67.81. 第一项改进仅捕捉建筑的好处;第二项改进捕捉在同一建筑接口下所吸取经验的额外好处。

blocks.en: Direct Builder skills. This baseline supplies the Target with the same meta-skill pack that the Builder receives in the corresponding variant of our method. The meta-skills’ when , provide , and use fields are appended to the Target’s instructions, and the Target is explicitly allowed to implement this guidance using its native tools and execution budget. No Builder-generated callbacks or resources are installed. The comparison thus holds access to learned knowledge fixed while changing whether a separate Builder implements that knowledge as harness support. Our full-bank method achieves higher scores in all six original settings, including 67.81 versus 42.38 for Gemini on Harness-Bench. These results support the benefit of having the Builder translate meta-skill guidance into concrete support before Target execution.
blocks.zh: 直接构建者技能. 这个基线为目标提供了与建设者在方法的对应变体中得到的相同的元技能包. 元技能 -- -- 当、提供和使用字段附于目标的指示之后,目标被明确允许使用其本土工具和执行预算来执行这一指导。 没有安装构建器生成的调用或资源 。 因此,这种比较使获得知识的机会固定不变,同时改变一个单独的构建者是否将这种知识用作利用支持。 我们的全库方法在所有6个原始设置中都取得了更高的分数,包括67.81比42.38在哈内斯-本奇的双子座. 这些成果有助于使建设者在目标执行之前将元技能指导转化为具体支持。

blocks.en: Independent Structured Target skills. This baseline learns skills specifically for the Target’s own problem-solving, using a separate GPT-5.6-Sol learner with no access to our Builder’s programs, trajectories, or meta-skill bank. Learning proceeds over two passes through the development set: the Target executes tasks in the neutral environment, and its current skill bank is supplied to subsequent executions as updates accumulate. Each update allows up to 8K output tokens and at most one skill addition or revision, with each skill limited to 192 tokens. The resulting bank is frozen and delivered directly to the Target at test time. Here, “independent” refers to the separately collected experience and separately learned bank; the extraction model remains the same. This baseline compares learning guidance for the Target’s task-solving procedures with learning principles for the Builder’s support design. Direct Target skill learning is competitive in several settings: Qwen scores 72.89 on Harness-Bench compared with our method’s 74.81, while Gemini scores 67.81 on NewtonBench compared with 68.84.
blocks.zh: 独立结构 目标技能. 这个基线专门为目标自身解决问题而学习技能,使用一个单独的GPT-5.6-Sol学习器,无法使用我们的构建者程序、轨迹或元技能库。 超过两个阶段的学习成果通过开发集:目标在中立环境中执行任务,随着更新的积累,其目前的技能库提供给随后的处决。 每次更新最多允许8K输出令牌,最多允许一个技能加成或修订,每个技能限制在192个令牌. 由此产生的银行被冻结,在测试时直接交付目标。 在此,“独立”是指单独收集的经验和单独学习的银行;提取模式保持不变。 这一基线将目标任务解决程序的学习指导与建设者支助设计的学习原则进行比较。 直接目标技能学习在几种情况下具有竞争力: 与我们的方法74.81相比,Quen在Harness-Bench上得72.89分,而双子座在牛顿Bench上得67.81分,相比之下68.84分.

blocks.en: Mined Free-Form Target skills. This baseline also uses GPT-5.6-Sol to extract problem-solving advice from independent Target experience, but replaces iterative structured updates with a single offline consolidation step. The Target first completes one pass through the development set, after which the learner consolidates all resulting trajectories into a note of at most 3K tokens. The learner freely chooses the content, format, and organization of this note, without prescribed skill fields or explicit add, revise, and keep operations. At test time, the frozen notes are supplied directly to the Target, with no separate harness construction or Builder-generated components. Results vary across Target–benchmark settings. On Harness-Bench, GPT-OSS scores 66.01 with free-form notes, compared with 56.63 with Independent Structured Target skills. On NewtonBench, Gemini scores 41.44 with free-form notes, compared with 67.81 with structured Target skills and 68.84 with our method. These comparisons show that the relative effectiveness of static free-form advice and iteratively learned structured skills depends on the evaluation settings and models.
blocks.zh: (原始内容存档于2017-09-21). Mined Free-Form Goalts. 这个基线还使用GPT-5.6-Sol从独立的Object体验中提取解决问题的建议,但将迭代结构化更新替换为单一的离线整合步骤. 目标首先完成一个通过开发集,之后学习者将所有产生的轨迹整合为最多3K个符的注释. 学习者自由选择本注释的内容,格式,组织,不规定技能领域或明确添加,修改,保持操作. 在测试时,冷冻纸币直接供应给目标,没有单独的吊带构造或构建器产生的组件. 目标-基准设置的结果各不相同。 在Harness-Bench上,GPT-OSS的成绩为66.01,有自由式笔记,而独立结构目标技能的成绩为56.63. 在牛顿奔驰上,双子座以自由式音符评分41.44分,相比之下,67.81分具有结构化的靶子技能,68.84分使用我们的方法. 这些比较表明,静态自由形式建议和反复学习的结构化技能的相对有效性取决于评价的设置和模式.

blocks.en: Appendix D Case Studies: From Meta-Skills to Executable Support
blocks.zh: 附录D 案例研究:从元技能到可执行支持

blocks.en: We present two successful full-bank test episodes with GPT-5.6-Sol as Builder and Gemini-3.6-Flash as Target . They illustrate complementary forms of support design: constructing a task-specific executable checker and coordinating an existing scientific interface through memory and control. Each case traces how a learned meta-skill informs the generated harness and how that support is used during Target execution. These selected cases provide qualitative insight into the resulting workflows, without estimating typical success rates or isolating the causal contributions of individual components.
blocks.zh: 我们以GPT-5.6-Sol为构建者, 以双子座-3.6-Flash为目标, 它们说明了辅助设计的补充形式:构建一个任务特定可执行检查器,并通过内存和控制协调现有的科学接口. 每个案例都追踪所学的元技能如何为生成的绳索提供信息,以及在目标执行期间如何使用这种支持。 这些选定的案例在质量上深入了解由此产生的工作流程,而没有估计典型的成功率或孤立各个组成部分的因果关系。

blocks.en: D.1 Making an artifact contract executable
blocks.zh: D.1 制作可执行的文物合同

blocks.en: Case 1: Builder connects artifact validation to submission Task and support problem. A metric-migration task in Harness-Bench asks Target to compare old and new metric definitions, query results, and dashboard snapshots under a migration policy. It requires four deliverables: a metric comparison, a regression ledger, a summary, and a caveat report. The challenge combines interpreting changes with keeping these deliverables complete and consistent. For example, a higher activation rate may be justified by a revised denominator, whereas a retention dashboard that still uses the old denominator violates the migration policy. Distinguishing these cases requires semantic judgment; ensuring that the resulting classifications agree across artifacts requires systematic bookkeeping. From a learned principle to executable support. The frozen bank provides a checkpointing meta-skill that calls for tracking output updates, validation status, and remaining budget, with a prompt finish after successful validation. It leaves evidence interpretation, drafting, and repair to Target . Builder implements this principle through task-specific instructions, an executable auditor, a controller, and a submission gate. The auditor is generated during harness construction, while Target subsequently authors all substantive deliverables. This division assigns mechanical verification to the harness and preserves Target ’s responsibility for the analysis. The auditor makes consistency requirements explicit. The generated auditor checks that the metric comparison covers every metric appearing in either query export exactly once, that reported values match the sources, that the regression ledger has the required coverage, and that the summary’s category counts agree with the comparison. It also verifies the presence of all required artifacts, their schemas, and numerical formatting. These checks specialize the public output requirements to the task’s actual inputs. For example, once Target labels a metric as an unexpected regression, the auditor can check whether the ledger and summary consistently reflect that decision. Determining whether the label is justified by the migration policy remains Target ’s responsibility. Validation governs the submission workflow. The controller tracks writes to the four deliverables and prompts Target to invoke the auditor once all four have been observed. A clean audit enables submission and prompts completion unless Target has identified a concrete semantic defect. Subsequent edits through the tracked file-writing interface invalidate the audit result and require another check. The submission gate enforces this dependency by withholding completion until the controller records a clean audit. Together, these components connect artifact creation, validation, and submission through an explicit readiness condition. Observed execution and outcome. In the recorded episode, Target reads the migration evidence, writes the four deliverables, and invokes the auditor, which reports zero errors and zero warnings. The resulting analysis covers five metrics: two expected definition changes, one unexpected regression, one with no material change, and one requiring review. The regression ledger identifies the retention dashboard’s continued use of the old cohort denominator, while the missing post-migration gross-margin value is left for review. Target then submits successfully, achieving a native score of 1.0 with 14 model calls and 15 counted tool calls. No repair iteration is needed. On the same task, no-skill construction and Direct-all produce no output artifacts and each score 0.0435, terminating because of token-budget exhaustion and model failure, respectively. Insight: support design separates judgment from bookkeeping. The reusable knowledge lies in recognizing which obligations can be made executable. Builder translates the checkpointing principle into checks for metric coverage, source-value fidelity, and agreement across deliverables. These obligations are straightforward to verify deterministically but compete for attention with interpreting migration evidence. By assigning them to generated code, the harness lets Target concentrate on substantive decisions while making their consistent expression across artifacts mechanically checkable. Insight: validation becomes actionable when it controls completion. The auditor supplies a capability, while the controller and submission gate determine when to use it and how its result changes the next action. A clean check establishes a concrete stopping condition, and an observed edit reopens validation. This episode demonstrates the successful draft–audit–submit path: the constructed workflow supports delivery of a complete, consistent answer within the execution budget. The comparison illustrates the potential value of this integrated support, although a single episode does not isolate the contribution of each component.
blocks.zh: 案例1:构建者将文物验证与提交任务和支持问题联系起来。 Harness-Bench的一项计量移徙任务要求Target根据一项移徙政策比较新旧的计量定义、查询结果和仪表板快照。 它需要四项可交付成果:衡量比较、回归分类账、摘要和说明报告。 挑战在于如何解释各种变化,同时保持这些可完成的工作和一致性。 例如,订正分母可以证明提高激活率是合理的,而仍然使用旧分母的留存仪表板则违反了迁移政策。 区分这些案例需要语义判断;确保由此产生的分类在各种文物之间达成一致需要系统记账。 从学到的原则到可执行支持. 被冻结的银行提供检查元技能,要求跟踪产出更新,验证状态,以及剩余预算,在验证成功后迅速完成. 它留下的证据解释、起草和修复给目标。 构建者通过特定任务指令,可执行审计员,控制器,以及提交门执行这一原则. 审计师是在利用设备建造过程中产生的,而目标组织随后编写所有实质性交付品。 该处负责机械核查,并保留目标的分析责任。 审计员明确了一致性要求。 生成的审计员核实,计量比较涵盖两次查询出口中每个计量,报告数值与来源相符,回归分类账有规定涵盖范围,汇总的分类数与比较一致。 它还核实所有所需文物的存在、其计划以及数字格式。 这些检查将公共产出要求专门用于任务的实际投入。 例如,一旦 " 目标 " 将衡量标准称为意外回归,审计员就可以检查分类账和汇总是否始终如一地反映这一决定。 确定移民政策是否合理仍然是目标的责任。 验证适用于提交工作流程。 控制器的轨迹是写给四个交付品的,并促使目标在所有四项都观察到后立即向审计员求助。 清理的审计有助于提交和促使完成,除非目标已查明具体的语义缺陷。 随后通过跟踪文件写入接口进行编辑,使审计结果无效,需要再次检查. 提交闸门通过在控制员记录干净的审计之前不完成来强制执行这种依赖性. 这些部件共同通过明确的准备状态,将文物的创造、验证和提交联系起来。 观察执行及结果. 在录制的剧集中,"目标"(Target)阅读了迁移证据,写了4个交付品,并援引了审计员的报告,审计员报告零错误和零警告. 由此产生的分析包括五个衡量标准:两个预期的定义变化、一个意外回归、一个没有重大变化、一个需要审查。 回归分类账确定留存仪表板继续使用旧的组分分母,而缺失的移民后总比值则留待审查。 然后目标成功提交,通过14个模式调用和15个计数工具调用实现1.0的本土分数. 不需要修复迭代。 在同一任务上,无技能建筑和直通不生产产出文物,每件都得分0.0435,分别因象征性预算耗尽和模型故障而终止. 透视:支持设计将判断与记账分开. 可重复使用的知识在于承认哪些义务可以执行。 建设者将检查站检查原则转化为对衡量覆盖面、源值忠诚度和跨交付品协议的检查。 这些义务可以直截了当地加以核实,但可以与解释移徙证据相竞争。 通过将它们分配到生成的代码,使目标专注于实质性决定,同时使其一致的表达方式跨出可机械核查的文物. 透视(Insight):当验证控制完成时,它就成为可操作性. 审计员提供一种能力,而控制员和提交闸门则决定何时使用这种能力以及其结果如何改变下一步行动。 清查确定混凝土停止状态,观察到的编辑重新开启验证. 这一集显示了成功的审计草稿提交路径:构建的工作流程支持在执行预算范围内提供完整、一致的答案。 比较表明这种综合支助的潜在价值,尽管一个插曲并不孤立每个组成部分的贡献。

blocks.en: D.2 Preserving scientific progress after computational failure
blocks.zh: D.2 计算失败后保留科学进步

blocks.en: Case 2: Builder preserves evidence and bounds failed computation Task and support problem. A NewtonBench task exposes a noise-free apparatus controlled by displacement x x and mass m m , which returns velocity after exponential energy loss. The requested quantity is the pre-loss elastic potential U ⁡ ( x ) U(x) , so the directly calculable kinetic energy E k = m ​ v 2 / 2 E_{k}=mv^{2}/2 must be corrected for the loss. Within ten tool calls, Target must design informative experiments, distinguish the measured observable from the requested quantity, infer the underlying law, and submit an executable function. The support problem combines a conceptual challenge—recovering latent energy from observations—with a procedural one: preserving enough evidence and budget to finish when computational analysis fails. From learned principles to coordinated support. Three learned meta-skills guide the construction: retain raw evidence while bounding analysis, reserve budget for submission, and distinguish the requested quantity from measured observables. Builder implements these principles through instructions, memory, a controller, and recovery and submission checks around the benchmark’s existing experimental and computational interfaces. The instructions direct Target to infer the energy-loss scale jointly with the displacement law and recommend duplicate inputs, cross-mass probes, and fresh measurements. The scientific hypothesis and its coefficients remain for Target to infer. Memory preserves evidence independently of analysis. The memory module stores recent experiment batches together with their inputs, separately from the latest computation result. A failed fitting attempt therefore leaves the measurements available for subsequent reasoning. Retrieval supplies the latest analysis result and up to four recent experiment batches to later model requests. In the recorded run, both earlier experiment batches are delivered again immediately after the second computation failure, making the accumulated evidence available at the point of recovery. Control bounds retries and preserves a path to submission. The controller counts failed computation calls and, after two failures, removes computation from the available tool menu while keeping experimentation and submission available. Recovery feedback directs Target to continue from retained measurements. When three or fewer tool or model calls remain, a finalization reminder asks Target to spend at most one further action on a concrete contradiction or fresh validation before preparing the submission. A separate submission check verifies the required response format and function signature. These mechanisms make recovery responsive to observed failures and remaining budget. Observed analysis and recovery. Target first collects a broad experiment batch containing duplicate inputs and cross-mass probes, followed by a second batch focused on small displacements. Two successful computation calls derive kinetic energy and compare candidate loss corrections. For example, at x = 0.01 x=0.01 , the observed kinetic energy is approximately 4.58571 4.58571 , while the candidate corrections E k ​ e 100 ​ x E_{k}e^{100x} and E k ​ e 50 ​ x E_{k}e^{50x} yield approximately 12.46524 12.46524 and 7.56055 7.56055 , respectively. These calculations explicitly connect the measured observable to hypotheses about pre-loss energy. The next two fitting attempts fail: one uses unsupported syntax, and the other exceeds the computational instruction limit. The controller then removes computation from the tool menu, and Target collects ten additional measurements at displacements between 0.0001 0.0001 and 0.001 0.001 . With three tool calls remaining, the finalization reminder activates, and Target proceeds to submission. Scientific result. Target submits the following law: U ^ ​ ( x ) = max ⁡ { 0 , 1241.9012 ​ x + 462.282 ​ x 2 } . \widehat{U}(x)=\max\{0,\;1241.9012\,x+462.282\,x^{2}\}. The native evaluator accepts the submission as equivalent to the reference law, reporting symbolic accuracy 1 and RMSLE 0. The run uses eight model calls and eight counted tool calls. On the same task, no-skill construction produces a valid but incorrect law, with symbolic accuracy 0 and RMSLE 0.092, while Direct-all ends with a model failure and no submission. The successful trajectory therefore includes an observed recovery from failed analysis to further measurement and completion. Insight: recovery connects evidence retention with action control. The initial guidance to keep computation bounded does not prevent two fitting failures. The constructed support nevertheless preserves a productive continuation: memory retains the measurements, the controller recognizes repeated failure, and the available actions change accordingly. Target can return to experimentation without losing its earlier evidence or spending the remaining budget on further computation retries. This case illustrates how a reusable recovery principle becomes an executable policy that responds to the actual trajectory. Insight: support components should match the bottleneck. The conceptual and procedural challenges receive different forms of support. Instructions clarify the distinction between observed and latent energy; memory maintains evidence continuity; and control limits unsuccessful analysis while reserving an opportunity to finish. Their coordination allows Builder to improve the use of an existing scientific interface. Target retains responsibility for choosing experiments and inferring the law, while the harness structures how evidence, failures, and remaining resources inform its next action.

blocks.en: Appendix E AI Use Statement
blocks.zh: 附录E AI 使用语句

blocks.en: In this work, LLMs are used strictly for research support rather than as sources of substantive content. Their use falls into three categories: (i) providing tested results on our AI4AI at test-time framework, and (ii) assisting with language refinement during paper writing. For writing support, we used ChatGPT solely to polish text (improving coherence and grammar) while all ideas, logic, results, and technical contributions originate from the authors. To safeguard rigor, we have carefully reviewed all LLM-refined texts to confirm that no hallucinated content was introduced and that the original arguments, findings, and perspectives were faithfully preserved.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,法学硕士严格用于研究支持而不是作为实质性内容的来源。 其使用分为三类:(一) 在测试时间框架内提供我们AI4AI的测试结果;(二) 在写纸过程中协助改进语言。 对于写作支持,我们只使用ChatGPT来擦亮文本(提高一致性和语法),而所有的想法,逻辑,结果,以及技术贡献都来自作者. 为了保证严谨,我们仔细审查了所有LLM精细的文本,以确认没有引入幻觉内容,并忠实地保留了最初的论点、调查结果和观点。
